body:
Finance operations / Source led

Check a small finance report with Claude

Find a duplicate, explain a variance and reconcile two tiny files.

You need: eligible paid Claude access; browser; synthetic files linked below.

  1. Get the practice files

    Download sample.csv, bank.csv and ledger.csv. These are fictional amounts.

    Look for: No company data or account connection.

  2. Add Finance

    In Claude, open Customize, then Plugins, Discover. Select Anthropic's Finance plugin and click Add.

    Look for: Finance appears among your plugins.

  3. Check the variance

    Attach sample.csv in a fresh chat. Ask: "Find duplicate IDs first. Deduplicate identical rows. Calculate revenue minus expenses for budget and actual, then explain the profit variance. Do not invent drivers."

    Look for: Duplicate E2; profit moves from 4,000 to 4,500.

  4. Reconcile the files

    In a fresh chat, attach bank.csv and ledger.csv. Select reconciliation from the / menu. Ask for unmatched IDs, mismatched amounts and both net totals.

    Look for: T3 differs; bank 500, ledger 550.

Check your result

  • Compare with expected totals.
  • Profit rises 500 (12.5%); bank minus ledger is -50.

If stuck: Missing plugin? Check your plan or organisation policy. To undo, remove practice chats/files and the plugin if unwanted.

Sources and limits / checked 14 November 2026

Inspired by Nicolas Boucher's finance-plugin tutorial: captions and four frames reviewed; workflow untested. Official setup; Finance scope. Fixture arithmetic was checked separately. Real reporting needs qualified review. Account cost varies; no financial advice or accuracy guarantee.

steps.action: Open Plugins. Check built-in capabilities first. Add plugin opens the native package dialog; inspect source, version and permissions before choosing Install, then Enable now. Add nothing you do not need.

Disable optional plugins you no longer need.

body:
Agents and harnesses / Source led

Start small with DeepSeek Harness

Choose a workspace and understand plugins before adding more tools.

You need: a supported computer; an existing model credential with known billing; a disposable environment and practice folder.

  1. Choose the official desktop app

    Start at DeepSeek's official page and choose your supported desktop download. Read the linked safety notice before installing.

    Look for: Developer preview, not a production-ready tool.

  2. Set a narrow workspace

    Use a practice folder containing only a made-up project note. In the UI, choose that workspace. Configure your existing model through Settings, Models; check its billing first.

    Look for: The selected workspace points to the practice folder.

  3. Inspect before adding

    Open Plugins. Check built-in capabilities first. Add plugin opens the native package dialog; inspect source, version and permissions before choosing Install, then Enable now. Add nothing you do not need.

    Look for: One understood capability, rather than a large bundle.

  4. Try one bounded task

    Ask: "Summarise the practice note in five bullets. Do not edit files, run commands or contact services." Compare the answer with the note.

    Look for: A faithful summary with no invented facts.

Check your result

  • Review the actual tool calls and file changes.
  • Disable optional plugins you no longer need.

If stuck: If chat is unavailable, check workspace selection and model configuration. Stop on unexpected actions; quit the app and preserve the practice folder for inspection.

Sources and limits / checked 14 November 2026

Checked against DeepSeek's README, UI guide and plugin manager. Official warning: unaudited experimental software; permission controls do not guarantee isolation. Setup and task were not executed. Model charges and compatibility are unknown.
